# Svarog walks into a solar & renewable energy firm

Walk into any solar & renewable energy outfit and watch for ten minutes. You will see a very old act performed with newer props. The act has a name. It is **Svarog**.

## Before the Office, the Story

**Origins.** Svarog appears in slavic tradition as sky, fire, smithing.  The name's meaning, "Bright, clear", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

**Worship and Memory.** Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Svarog in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.
